verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an MCP server that lets external LLM clients (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) call Adyen APIs via natural language, and 'Uplift' AI-driven payment optimization recommendations, but neither is a built-in assistant embedded inside Adyen's own product (e.g., Customer Area) that a user delegates tasks to — the MCP server explicitly requires 'your chosen LLM client' external to Adyen. No evidence of an in-product conversational AI assistant exists.
